endpoints.finding_headline: GET /members/{id}: no security requirement is declared for this operation (unlike every other data-bearing endpoint in the spec), yet it returns role and contactEmail — full member PII readable with no bearer token at all

GET /orders?memberId={id}: listOrders takes memberId as a client-supplied query parameter with no stated ownership check, in contrast to GET /orders/{id} which the spec explicitly documents as 'scoped to the bearer's own member id'

POST /invoices: createInvoice accepts an orderId in the request body with no described check that the order belongs to the caller, allowing a member to generate an invoice against another member's order

PUT /members/{id}/role: setMemberRole only requires a valid memberToken bearer with no described privilege check, so any authenticated member could set any member's role field, including their own, to an elevated value
